item.title: Magic: The Gathering Casts Stranger Things Star as Female Lead
item.description: Legendary Entertainment and Hasbro's live-action Magic: The Gathering movie is one step closer to reality. According to two new reports, Stranger Things and Inside Out 2 star Maya Hawke has been cast in a lead role in director Matt Johnson's adaptation of the 33-year-old trading card game. Hawke's role has not been announced, but one report says the actor is filling a "key" role in Magic: The Gathering .

item.title: New D&D Book Introduces Some of the Most Terrifying Boss Fights in the Game’s History
item.description: Vecna is arguably the archetypical "boss character" in Dungeons & Dragons . For almost 40 years now, Vecna's machinations have endangered D&D's multiverse, only to be opposed and defeated but never permanently destroyed by groups of outmatched adventurers. In his last outing, Vecna: Eve of Ruin , Vecna is designed to be a unique threat who's capable of winning against a party of 20th-level adventurers. On Azeroth, however, he'd just be another face in the crowd.

item.title: Brandon Sanderson’s Mistborn TTRPG Lays the Groundwork for His Next Series
item.description: Last year, Brotherwise Games published a set of three tabletop role-playing game books set in the world of Brandon Sanderson’s epic fantasy series The Stormlight Archive . The company quickly followed up the project by announcing an expansion to the Cosmere RPG based on Sanderson’s Mistborn setting, and the new books reveal the true scope of the company’s ambitions.

item.title: PS Plus Makes James Bond’s New Game Free for Just One Hour
item.description: 007 First Light starts with a bang. James Bond’s latest mission begins with a cold-open action sequence that segues into one of the best video game tutorials in recent memory . PlayStation Plus members can now try that impressive introduction for free.

item.title: GTA 6 Sells Nearly 8 Million Copies Before It Even Launches, Report Says
item.description: The anticipation surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 is reaching a fever pitch as Rockstar Games' long-awaited open-world adventure gets closer to its launch. Between fans dissecting every trailer, an alligator Xbox sweepstakes capitalizing on the hype, and players preparing their hard drives for the massive download , it's clear that few games have generated this much excitement ahead of launch.

item.title: 5 Elder Scrolls 6 Fan Theories That Should Actually Happen In Sentinel
item.description: For its 40th anniversary, legendary developer Bethesda gave its fans the best possible gift: another The Elder Scrolls 6 tease . Yeah. But wait, this time, we got a title! One that the community had already guessed years ago. But beggars can’t be choosers. At this point, the Elder Scrolls series has garnered enough goodwill from players that we can happily eat this new breadcrumb and keep waiting for the game. Just a little bit more.

item.title: Where to use the blackmarket weapons locker key in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: The Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ blackmarket weapons locker key is one of many keys in the extraction mode, and it's used to open, as you may have guessed from its name, a locker that can contain rare weapons and loot. Much like the gun store weapons locker key , however, the blackmarket weapons locker key can be used in two different locations.

item.title: God of War Laufey Hit With Big Delay
item.description: Sony Santa Monica has announced it has made the decision to delay God of War Laufey . The upcoming spinoff game of the iconic PlayStation series was initially slated to be released next February, but players will now have to wait a few extra months to get their hands on it. The studio has set a new release date for the PlayStation 5 exclusive, pushing the game to May 2027.

item.title: Nintendo's Biggest Chip Manufacturer Officially Exits Business
item.description: As players continue to reel from Sony’s announcement that the company will stop producing physical discs for its games starting in 2028, fans of physical media have suffered another blow. It just got a lot harder for Nintendo to produce physical Switch game cartridges.

item.title: Stormlight Archive 6 Gets a Major Official Update From Brandon Sanderson
item.description: Fans of fantasy author Brandon Sanderson are probably familiar with his weekly update videos. These, as the name suggests, are a place for the author to check in with his audience about the state of his numerous ongoing projects, which are visualized through the use of progress bars. In the latest video, Sanderson made the exciting announcement that we will soon see a new progress bar appear. That's because work on the next Stormlight Archive book has begun.
